notes: Spells you typed as Damage no longer skip targets an instakill wouldn't work on. Every reason the assistant refuses a target — a named boss, a reaper, a monster it has watched shrug off Finger of Death, a creature type that ignores death or mind magic — exists because an instakill or a hold would be wasted. None of it stops a nuke, but damage spells were being held to the same rules and so were sitting idle exactly where you most want them. Damage now ignores all of it. The one exception kept is negative energy: a necromancy damage spell still skips undead and constructs, which absorb it. Instakills and crowd control are unchanged and keep every guard.
